描述_EN: the interior is painted in coloured pigments, which would have made the wine undrinkable. if it was indeed a wine container then it was intended as a mortuary object, something that was meant to be buried, not for daily use. it is also possible that it was a wine vessel. the shape of this circular container is similar to toilet boxes scientifically excavated in china.
